parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Scenarios: 2 pianists, 3 violinists, 2 guitarists: $\binom{8}{2}\binom{4}{2}\binom{6}{3}=28\times6\times20=3360$; 2 pianists, 4 violinists, 1 guitarist: $\binom{8}{2}\binom{4}{1}\binom{6}{4}=28\times4\times15=1680$; 3 pianists, 3 violinists, 1 guitarist: $\binom{8}{3}\binom{4}{1}\binom{6}{3}=56\times4\times20=4480$; 4 pianists, 2 violinists, 1 guitarist: $\binom{8}{4}\binom{4}{1}\binom{6}{2}=70\times4\times15=4200$. M1 (An expression $\binom{8}{r}\binom{4}{r}\binom{6}{r}$ with the three selected counts summing to 7.)
B1 (Two unsimplified products correct.)
M1 (Summing the numbers of ways for 3 or 4 correct scenarios.)
Total $=13\,720$. A1.
Total: 4.

steps.working: Forms a valid product $\binom8p\binom4g\binom6v$ for a composition with $p+g+v=7$.
Two of the four valid products for $(p,g,v)=(2,2,3),(2,1,4),(3,1,3),(4,1,2)$ are correct and unsimplified.
Sums the numbers of ways for three or four correct scenarios.
